summary: 1 problem(s) with SSH, mosh or tmux

checks.label: Hardening /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/010-tau.conf
checks.detail: keys only; only alice, only from the tailnet and localhost

action.text: Run this in your own terminal, as yourself and not with sudo: it asks for your password (sudo) only for the steps that need root. tau never runs it.
changes: installs tmux and mosh with Homebrew
adds a tau block to ~/.zshenv (Homebrew on PATH, so mosh-server starts over SSH) and to ~/.tmux.conf, and links tau-attach into ~/.local/bin
loads the keep-awake agent com.tau.keepawake (caffeinate -s, on AC power only), unless TauBar is installed
installs Tailscale.app with Homebrew if it is missing

with sudo: writes /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/010-tau.conf: keys only (password and keyboard-interactive login off), only your user from the tailnet and localhost (AllowUsers), no agent forwarding; tests it with sshd -t and rolls it back if the test fails
with sudo: creates missing SSH host keys (ssh-keygen -A) and turns on Remote Login, or tells you where to switch it on
